C1.worst_defect: The top nav puts "Try with your store" next to "Live demo" as an equal choice, but it links straight to https://app.vendurepos.com, which only works after a server plugin is installed; the warning appears only in the small grey line under the hero buttons, so a newcomer who clicks the nav link lands on a sign-in form asking for a store URL and admin password.
C1.where: home.desktop.01 header nav + hint line under the CTAs; same link in the docs sidebar (quick-start.desktop.01)

C2.worst_defect: The home comparison table says the demo "sends is anonymous usage events to ph.wcpos.com" without saying what wcpos.com is or how it relates to VendurePOS. The explanation (a self-hosted PostHog) is only on Connect a till, and no page says who is behind the project.
C2.where: home.desktop.02 table row "Sales reach Vendure, once each, even offline"; home.phone.04

C3.worst_defect: The Node version requirement ("Node ^20.19 || >=22.12") appears only on Plugin setup. Quick start's intro and the home page's "Before you start" list just Vendure 3.6+ and Postgres, so the quick start's own prerequisites are incomplete.
C3.where: quick-start.desktop.01 intro paragraph vs plugin-setup.desktop.01 "Check your store"

C4.worst_defect: The changelog is written in internal shorthand that is never linked or explained: "(ADR 0005)", "order.create v5", "(#116)", "(#117)". The ADR and issue references go nowhere, so a reader can't follow them.

C5.worst_defect: The hero screenshot of the till is cropped through a fourth row of product tiles, so a strip of cut-off tile tops sits along its bottom edge and the image looks unfinished. The same happens in dark mode.
C5.where: home.desktop.01 bottom of the hero image (y≈1140-1155); home.desktop-dark.jpg

C6.worst_defect: On a 390 px screen, code blocks soft-wrap in the middle of expressions. The generateMigration call breaks over five lines with 'AddVendurePos' and './src/migrations' split apart, and import paths drop onto their own lines, so it is hard to read and to check what you copied.

C7.worst_defect: Mobile LCP on / and /docs/quick-start is 2.4 s, close to the 2.5 s threshold, and Lighthouse flags 52 KiB of unused JavaScript and 150 ms of render-blocking requests on the home page.

overall_worst.defect: "Try with your store" is a top-level nav link (header and docs sidebar) that goes straight to the app's sign-in screen. A first-time visitor who doesn't yet have the plugin on a Vendure server hits a dead end asking for a store URL and admin password, and the only warning is a small caption under the hero buttons.
overall_worst.fix: Point the nav "Try with your store" link to /docs/quick-start (or a short anchor that says "needs @vendurepos/plugin on your server first" with the app link below), or relabel it "Open the app (plugin required)".
